identity.title: Share the active decoded C3D source snapshot

origin.kind: owner continuation request and 2026-08-22 project analysis
origin.summary: The owner deferred R0 and authorized the next analyzed development item: remove audited avoidable full-size C3D copies without changing inspection behavior.

state.current_summary: PL-0036 is resolved: the active source session shares one binding-verified decoded snapshot, C3D decode is streaming, Height Image retains read-only source values, and all current gates pass.

objective.summary: Let active Workbench source consumers share one immutable decoded C3D snapshot and remove avoidable full-source byte/value copies.
constraints: Keep the existing ToolWorkbenchSourceSession as the owner; add no general cache or out-of-core storage abstraction.
Preserve exact C3D byte identity, raw-height values, missing-cell semantics, source-quality results, and Height Image pixels/cell reads.
Source replacement and cancellation must prevent stale results from becoming visible.
Loading and presentation must not invoke Preview, Publish, Run, Validation, or recipe mutation.
Keep standalone Source Quality and Height Image load entry points compatible.
Do not claim representative maximum-C3D memory or load-time qualification without the missing source and accepted budgets.

criteria.text: The active ToolWorkbenchSourceSession owns one asynchronous decoded C3D snapshot per exact path/entity/unit/frame source key and replaces or clears it when the source changes.
Workbench Source Quality and Height Image routes consume the same session snapshot while standalone consumers retain their existing path-based fallback.
C3DHeightImageFrame retains the snapshot value memory instead of copying all values, with identical cell and rendered-pixel behavior.
C3DHeightFieldSnapshot hashes and parses a source in one streaming pass without retaining a whole-file byte array, preserving exact identity and validation failures.
Focused snapshot-sharing/value-identity verification, proportional Release builds, the structure guard, and diff hygiene pass with D-backed evidence.

context.summary: Current source identity, binding, and acquisition provenance already belong to this session.
Both consumers decode the same path independently, and Height Image copies the complete decoded value array again.
Representative maximum-C3D qualification remains blocked on a representative input and accepted memory/load-time limits.
Product-owner Wide/Compact R0 remains explicitly deferred.

artifacts.summary: Durable PL-0036 scope, ownership transition, acceptance results, verification, and boundaries.

evidence.observation: Shared snapshot and Source Quality passed 24/24, Inspection Workspace and Height Image passed 64/64, C3D profile passed 14/14, and distribution passed 26/26 against the final Release build.
The full Release solution built with zero warnings and zero errors; the code-structure guard passed 67/67.
Source inspection confirms one source-session task, binding-verified sharing, incremental fixed-buffer hash/decode, no source ReadAllBytes, and no Height Image source.Values.ToArray copy.
The closure, master backlog, current handoff, project analysis, documentation index, and v2 issue record describe the same completed scope and maximum-input/R0 boundaries.

events.summary: Resolved after exact shared-reference and identity checks, Height Image/C3D regressions, full Release build, structure proof, and durable documentation passed.
